channel.description: We are Chaos Core Tech, we like to make things. We 3D model using Blender, ZBrush and Fusion 360. We do 3D printing with both FDM and resin machines. videos.desc:

The whole thing is powered by a 9V battery but could easily be adjusted to use AA or AAA. Some tips if you try this yourself. Have the LEDs as close to the protoboard as possible. Experiment with different LEDs to find which ones you like best. You'll need screws and nuts for the 3 part print to hold it together. With the one part print you won't need to use any.
